claims.statement: The official BDO user documentation says its waste-records module supports waste records and creation of waste transfer cards (KPO).
Official BDO material describes the electronic KPO as a condition for lawful transfer where the record-keeping obligation applies.
Official BDO guidance states that entities carrying out services as waste producers can be required to register and keep records in BDO.

contrary_evidence: BDO is already the official system of record, so customers may tolerate manual invoice checks rather than buy another layer.
Large waste operators may already reconcile scales and billing inside proprietary systems.

economics.acquisition_route: Sell a 60-day one-stream leakage audit via BDO consultants and weighbridge vendors, then expand to all sites and counterparties
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 180 sites at 3,000 PLN monthly yields 6.48m PLN ARR by years 5-6. A 20-30% operating margin, retained earnings and a 4-5x vertical-software valuation could create over 5m PLN of founder-owned value in years 6-8.
economics.founder_time: 14-20 hours weekly during the first three connectors, then partner-led onboarding with exception-only founder review
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 75-89% after connector reuse; first-stream mapping and ambiguous waste-code review remain service-heavy
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 2-6 months when audit recovery funds the first-year subscription
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 1,500-6,000 PLN per site monthly or 1-4 PLN per matched transfer, plus 10-20% of verified historical recoveries
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every pickup generates a document, weight and invoice; historical counterparty behavior improves checks and increases switching cost

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Waste-code, route, counterparty and scale discrepancy graph plus benchmark contamination/rate adjustments, producing better expected-value checks over time
fingerprint.customer: Polish multi-site waste generators, collectors and industrial facilities with recurring documented waste transfers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: White-label through BDO consultants, waste brokers, weighbridge vendors and facilities-management providers with installed client bases
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Site-and-volume SaaS plus a one-off historical recovery audit; connectors for BDO exports, scales, telematics and ledgers
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A generator or collector pays when a waste stream is continuously matched and its invoice exceptions are resolved before approval
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A KPO, measured weight, agreed tariff, pickup event and supplier/customer invoice disagree or a required document is incomplete

founder_fit: Multi-source anomaly detection is directly aligned with the founder's technical skills.
A historical file audit is a low-capital, part-time validation wedge.
Consultant and vendor channels reduce ongoing social load.
risks: Incorrect matching must never silently alter official waste records.
Waste-code interpretation can require domain expertise and varies by process.
Counterparties may resist sharing rate and adjustment data.

structure.control_point: Approval of a waste pickup invoice and closure of the corresponding BDO transfer record
structure.critical_dependency: Consistent export/API access from BDO and operational systems, plus customers willing to share commercially sensitive weights and rates

thesis: Create a reconciliation twin for Polish waste generators, collectors and multi-site industrial firms that matches each BDO waste-transfer card to scales, vehicle arrival, contract rate, contamination adjustment, invoice and payment. The initial service audits one waste stream and recovers weight/rate/document exceptions before automating approval. Distribution through waste consultants, weighbridge software and facility-management firms offers a route around direct cold sales. The product does not replace the official BDO record or certify legal compliance.
title: Waste Transfer Invoice Twin
uncertainties: Practical BDO data-access method for multi-site clients
Best initial stream: construction, packaging, hazardous or production waste
